edges.reason: msg.sender is written into _owner during initialization and ownership transfer.
msg.sender becomes the new top bidder in bidOnAuction.
msg.sender is the recipient of the purchased token in buyToken.
msg.sender is the mint recipient in mint.
msg.sender must equal allowedAddress and is the mint recipient in mintAllow.
msg.sender controls which version mapping entry is written in updateVersion.
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo random entropy in _random.
msg.sender is the approving owner in setApprovalForAll.
msg.sender is checked as caller in approve.
msg.sender is checked as approved or owner in transferFrom.
onlyOwner relies on msg.sender being the owner in setAltSigner.
onlyOwner relies on msg.sender being the owner in setRoyalties.
msg.sender is assigned as the owner inside _init.
msg.sender must be the token owner to obtain the sale hash.
block.timestamp must exceed the auction end time to allow settlement.
block.timestamp gates bid acceptance and auction extension.
block.timestamp must be before the auction end time on creation.
block.timestamp decides whether start or end times may be modified.
block.timestamp is used as randomness entropy in _random.
block.timestamp drives the descending price computation.
createAuction writes the token to auction id mapping, locking the token.
createAuction stores the new Auction struct.
bidOnAuction updates price, bidder and end timestamp in the auction struct.
settleAuction reads the auction struct to determine buyer and price.
settleAuction clears the token to auction id mapping.
cancelAuction clears the token to auction id mapping.
alterAuctionTime writes back modified start and end timestamps.
buyToken requires the seller's active version to match the provided version.
mint requires the owner's active version to match the provided version.
mintAllow requires the owner's active version to match the provided version.
updateVersion writes the caller's active signature version.
_markHashSold records the hash as finalized to prevent replay.
cancelSale marks the order hash as cancelled.
setAltSigner changes the alternate signer address used for authorizations.
setRoyalties overwrites the royalties address array.
setRoyalties overwrites the royalties BPS array.
setSecondaryBPS changes the secondary owner basis points.
_init sets the owner from the addresses array.
_init sets the hardcoded payout contract address.
_init sets the alternate signer address.
_init sets maxSupply from the uint array.
_init sets transactionMax from the uint array.
_init sets maxMint from the uint array.
_init calls into secondary BPS configuration.
_init sets timePerDecrement, defaulting when zero.
lockTokenURI flips isRevealed to true.
lockTokenURI sets the reveal offset.
lockTokenURI sets the random mint offset.
lockTokenURI may reduce maxSupply to the current total supply.
tokenURI applies the reveal offset to the token id.
tokenURI branches on the isRevealed flag.
tokenURI takes the modulo of maxSupply when computing the offset id.
_transfer decrements and increments balances.
_transfer rewrites the owner entry for the token.
_mint increments the recipient balance.
_mint records the new owner.
_burn decrements the owner balance.
_burn deletes the owner entry.
_mintRandom increments the per-wallet mint count.
_mintRandom enforces the maxMint limit.
_mintRandom branches between random and sequential minting on isRevealed.
_mintRandomIndex reads and writes the indices swap-and-pop array.
_mintRandomIndex computes remaining supply from maxSupply.
_currentPrice divides elapsed time by timePerDecrement.
royaltyInfo computes the royalty from secondaryOwnerBPS.
_init invokes _setRoyalties during configuration.
_init invokes _setSecondary during configuration.
buyToken calls _currentPrice to price the sale.
mint calls _currentPrice to price the mint.
buyToken validates and finalizes the order via _markHashSold.
buyToken transfers the token from the seller to the buyer.
settleAuction transfers the token to the winning bidder.
settleAuction forwards ETH to an external payout contract before completing state assumptions.
buyToken forwards ETH to the external payout contract.
mint forwards ETH to the external payout contract.
mintAllow forwards ETH to the external payout contract.
bidOnAuction sends the previous bid back to a caller controlled address.
buyToken refunds excess ETH to the caller.
mint refunds excess ETH to the caller.
mintAllow refunds excess ETH to the caller.
_markHashSold recovers the signer address from the signature.
mint recovers the signer from the supplied signature.
mintAllow recovers the signer from the supplied signature.
mint multiplies amount by unit price to compute the total.
mintAllow multiplies price by buyAmount to compute the total.
_mintRandom calls _mintRandomIndex when the collection is revealed.
_mintRandom calls _mint for sequential pre-reveal minting.
_mintRandomIndex draws a random index via _random.
_mintRandomIndex safely mints the chosen token id.
_safeMint performs the receiver hook check.
_checkOnERC721Received calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract, giving it control.
tokenId parameter selects which token is placed on auction.
tokenId parameter selects the auction to settle.
signature authorizes the lazy sale in buyToken.
signature authorizes the public mint order.
signature authorizes the allowlist mint order.
signature is recovered inside _markHashSold.
pricesAndTimestamps provides the curve parameters to _currentPrice.
pricesAndTimestamps is part of the signed sale order in buyToken.
pricesAndTimestamps is part of the signed mint order.
pricesAndTimestamps is forwarded through mintAllow.
pricesAndTimestamps is hashed inside _markHashSold.
amount determines how many tokens mint issues.
amount bounds the buyAmount in mintAllow.
amount is passed to _mintRandom.
amount drives the loop count in _mintRandomIndex.
totalPrice is compared against msg.value in mint.
totalPrice is compared against msg.value in mintAllow.
msgValue is used to compute the refund in mint.
msgValue is used to compute the refund in mintAllow.
hash is checked for cancellation and recovered in _markHashSold.
auction memory copy supplies the winner and price to settleAuction.
auction memory copy supplies current bid state to bidOnAuction.
auction memory copy is modified and written back in alterAuctionTime.
prevBidder determines the refund target in bidOnAuction.
prevPrice determines the refund amount and minimum bid in bidOnAuction.
index is used to look up and update the indices array.
totalSize bounds the remaining supply loop.
rand is the pseudo random value returned modulo max by _random.
nextTokenId seeds the sequential pre-reveal mint loop.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenId parameter is a scalar input consumed directly by the createAuction core function.
signature parameter is only meaningful as buyer input to the buyToken core function.
pricesAndTimestamps is a transient input fully normalized into the price curve computation.
amount parameter is a caller supplied scalar normalized into the mint core function.
totalPrice local is a temporary arithmetic result inside mint.
msgValue local caches msg.value inside mintAllow for the refund computation.
hash local is the transient order hash validated by _markHashSold.
auction memory copy exists only to read auction state during settlement.
prevBidder local is a temporary cache used for the refund in bidOnAuction.
prevPrice local is a temporary cache used for the refund in bidOnAuction.
index local is a temporary random index inside _mintRandomIndex.
totalSize local tracks the remaining supply inside _mintRandomIndex.
rand local is the transient entropy digest inside _random.
nextTokenId local is a transient counter inside _mintRandom.
